title: Elite party cues increase vaccination intentions among Republicans
claim: Among unvaccinated Republican or Republican-leaning participants, a Republican elite endorsement increases vaccination intentions relative to a Democratic elite endorsement.

reproduction.reason: The canonical audit did not execute the frozen author-directed reproduction targets.

robustness_comparison.scope_limit: The paths differ as a scientifically indivisible adjustment, covariate-definition and listwise-sample bundle. Minimality is bounded to the frozen registry.

material_limitations: The source interval confidence level and model-specific analytic sample size were not established.
The displayed percentage interpretation has no established denominator or transformation.
The paper and analysis code describe an unvaccinated population, while supplementary wording describes a vaccinated population.
No comparable independent replication was established by the targeted evidence search.
